tagline: Not sure where you fit yet? Start here — and find out.
description: A 12-week exploratory path through the core areas of cybersecurity — web, network, and cloud — designed to help you discover which specialization excites you most before you commit.
outcome: A working foundation across all major security domains, plus clarity on which specialization to pursue next.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Security Fundamentals
phases.subtitle: Weeks 1–4 · Build the base every specialization needs

items.title: What is Cybersecurity, Really?
items.detail: CIA triad, threat actors, and the different career paths inside security.

items.title: Linux & Command Line Basics
items.detail: Every security tool assumes you're comfortable in a terminal — get there first.

items.title: Networking Basics
items.detail: IP addresses, ports, and how devices actually talk to each other.

items.title: Mini Project: Set Up a Home Security Lab
items.detail: Install a Linux VM and a vulnerable practice target like Metasploitable.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Sample Every Domain
phases.subtitle: Weeks 5–8 · Taste web, network, and cloud security

items.title: Intro to Web Security
items.detail: OWASP Top 10 basics and your first XSS/SQLi lab.

items.title: Intro to Network Security
items.detail: Capture your first packets with Wireshark and spot a plaintext password.

items.title: Intro to Cloud Security
items.detail: Spin up a free-tier AWS account and explore IAM basics.

items.title: Mini Project: Try a CTF for Beginners
items.detail: Complete a beginner-friendly capture-the-flag event end to end.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Choose Your Direction
phases.subtitle: Weeks 9–12 · Pick a specialization and go deeper

items.title: Reflect & Decide
items.detail: Which domain felt most engaging? That's usually the right signal.

items.title: Security+ Fundamentals
items.detail: A vendor-neutral cert that strengthens whichever path you choose next.

items.title: Join a Security Community
items.detail: Discord servers, local meetups, or CTF teams to keep momentum and get feedback.

items.title: Start Your Specialization Roadmap
items.detail: Come back to Bugitrix and generate a focused roadmap for your chosen path.
